title: The v16 StrKey decoder checks the checksum but not the per-type payload rules
severity_basis: Acceptance of invalid input (SEP-23 invalid vectors return a payload). The strict decoder exists only on the 17.x line; 16.x is a maintenance line. The signed-payload framing vectors (strkey/synthetic-gap-vectors.signed-payload-65-byte, .signed-payload-empty, .signed-payload-nonzero-padding) were fixed specifically by #1588 (merged into the v17 feature branch on 2026-08-04), which reached the default branch with #1580.

evidence.post_fix: js@17.2.0 and later reject the same vectors.
evidence.expected_basis: SEP-23 v1.4.0 lists these strkeys as invalid (stellar-protocol at f2d36490).

reproduction.method: Independent reviewer reproduction from the record alone on 2026-11-12: 33 of 33 listed report rows failed again as recorded, all offline. Review: findings/review/F-0019.json.

evidence_added.reason: Fixed upstream; the upstream item already carries the reproduction and the fix, so no new evidence is added. The 16.x maintenance line receives critical security fixes only (js-stellar-sdk SECURITY.md); no backport request is drafted unless a maintainer decides to ask for one.
